title: Toni's Porchetta
summary: Italian rolled and stuffed pork belly with crispy crackling. The rich filling combines pork mince, chicken liver and herbs for intense flavour. Perfect for special occasions or Sunday roast.

steps.text: Heat olive oil in frying pan. Cook onions and garlic until soft (5 minutes).
Add pork mince, cook until browned. Add chicken livers, cook for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in pine nuts, lemon zest, sage, rosemary, thyme. Season well with salt and pepper. Remove from heat, cool completely.
Lay pork belly skin-side down on work surface. Score the meat side lightly with knife.
Spread cooled filling evenly over meat side, leaving 2cm border around edges.
Roll tightly from one long side, with skin on outside. Tie securely with kitchen string at 3cm intervals.
Pat skin very dry with kitchen paper. Rub skin generously with salt and olive oil. Slash skin with sharp knife in crisscross pattern.
Place on roasting rack, refrigerate uncovered for 2-4 hours (or overnight) to dry skin further.
Preheat oven to 250°C. Roast porchetta for 30 minutes until skin starts to crackle.
Reduce heat to 120°C. Continue roasting for 1 hour until cooked through (internal temp 70°C).
Rest for 15 minutes. Remove string, slice into thick rounds. Serve hot.

tips: The secret to perfect crackling is dry skin and high initial heat. Pat skin completely dry before scoring and salting. The overnight refrigeration step is optional but produces superior crackling. Tighten the rolled belly properly and ensure kitchen string is secure at regular intervals. The filling can be made a day ahead. Porchetta is traditionally served at room temperature in Italy, making it perfect for gatherings.
